properties.description: First stage of the performance pass. Provide granular visibility for each test: identity, what behavior it exercises, what it does/checks, duration and result, with supporting detail/evidence as agreed in the joint sessions. Clarify test-level timing versus suite, build, setup and other overhead so the display is truthful. Follow joint needs analysis → joint image-generation rounds → design review → development → post-development human UI review. The exact design and measurement contract remain proposals until reviewed.
